primitives.name: Database Synchronization and Backfill Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Backfill all settled 2026 regular-season NFL games (Weeks 1–5 plus Week 6 TNF SEA@DEN, commenceTime >= '2026-09-01' and < '2026-10-17', mergedIntoGameId IS NULL) from `games` into `team_game_logs` for all 32 NFL teams.
primitives.assumptions: All games within time range are settled and not merged; 32 teams exist in team_game_logs.

layer2.mapping: Each game entry maps to 32 team entries in team_game_logs via join on teamId.
layer2.telemetry: Row count in team_game_logs per team >= 4, max(gameDate) >= '2026-10-04'

primitives.name: Rest Day Calculation Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: Recalculate and update `restDaysAway` and `restDaysHome` on all 14 Week 6 NFL `games` rows to true rest days (ensuring all <= 14, zero 56 or 57 values).
primitives.assumptions: Games are ordered chronologically; last game date is known per team.
primitives.breakdown_regime: All 14 Week 6 games with valid prior game dates

layer2.mapping: Computed rest days derived from game schedule and previous game dates.
layer2.telemetry: All values in [0, 14], none at 56 or 57

primitives.name: Edge Score Normalization Function
primitives.verbatim_quote: Update published Week 6 NFL `picks` rows: normalize edgeScores (from 76-77 down to 52-54), ensure non-empty reasoning (>250 chars), populate `injuryEvidence` and `continuityDeltas`, and ensure `noBet: null`.
primitives.assumptions: Raw scores lie in [76, 77]; linear transformation preserves monotonicity.

layer2.mapping: Linear rescaling of raw edge scores to target interval [52, 54].
